findings.title: Off-by-one error in totalPages calculation when user_count is a multiple of limit
findings.body: In `app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-group.js.es6`, `totalPages` is computed as `Math.floor(this.get("user_count") / this.get("limit")) + 1`. When `user_count` is an exact multiple of `limit` (for example, 50 users with a limit of 50), this returns `2` instead of `1`, allowing the user to paginate to an empty second page. It should use `Math.ceil(this.get("user_count") / this.get("limit"))` (or `Math.floor((user_count - 1) / limit) + 1`).

findings.title: Admin::GroupsController#create ignores alias_level parameter
findings.body: In `app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb`, the `create` action sets `group.name` and `group.visible` from `params`, but never assigns `group.alias_level` even though the admin form displays the alias level selector on new groups and `Discourse.Group#asJSON` sends `alias_level` in the POST payload. Any alias level chosen when creating a group is silently discarded.

findings.title: Adding an already-existing group member raises ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique
findings.body: In `Admin::GroupsController#add_members`, `group.add(user)` (which does `group.users.push(user)`) is called for each username without checking whether the user is already a member of the group (`group.users.include?(user)` or `group.group_users.where(user_id: user.id).exists?`). If an admin submits a username that is already in the group, the uniqueness constraint on `group_users (group_id, user_id)` raises an unhandled `ActiveRecord::RecordNotUnique` (500 error) instead of ignoring the duplicate or returning a validation error.

findings.title: Unbounded and negative limit/offset parameters in GroupsController#members
findings.body: In `GroupsController#members`, `limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i` and `offset = params[:offset].to_i` are passed directly to `.limit(limit).offset(offset)` without bounds checking. A client can pass a very large `limit` to load and serialize all users in a large group in a single request, or pass negative values which cause Postgres to raise an `ActiveRecord::StatementInvalid` (`LIMIT/OFFSET must not be negative`). `limit` should be clamped (e.g. between 1 and a maximum like 1000) and `offset` should be clamped to `>= 0`.
